title: CPU-vs-GPU byte-identity regression for DVB-T2 chain
description:
## Goal

Regression test asserting byte-identity of the four deterministic
columns across {CPU-only, CPU-parallel, CPU+GPU} executions at
the same seed for all six in-scope DVB-T2 MODCODs.

## Context

Task under story `5d0a3fad` (DVB-T2 BICM application on
gf2-sim) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Regression test asserts byte-identity of `fer` /
  `frames` / `errors` / `mean_iters` across {CPU-only,
  CPU-parallel-24-thread, CPU+GPU on gfx1030} at the same seed
  for all six DVB-T2 MODCODs.

## Non-goals

BER excluded from byte-identity per status-quo contract.
